name: Amafuki Setsuka
source:
[url=/c881]Protagonist's[/url] half-sister and a 3rd-year student. Because of some reasons they were separated but they met again in school. She has a huge brother complex... Isei also has a huge sister complex to make up for it. She’s the perfect housewife who knows how to cook, clean and stuff like that. She’s scary when she’s angry, though.
